answer: The canyon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the relic of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
